title: Fix os:start/os:dev scripts to use local CLI package
body:
`pnpm os:start` fails with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` because the scripts reference `node_modules/@objectstack/cli/bin/objectstack.js`, an external package that isn't installed. The local `packages/cli` already provides identical `serve`/`dev` commands and is used by 6 other root scripts (`cli`, `objectui`, `doctor`, `studio`, `check`, `generate`).

- **Root `package.json`**: Updated `os:start` and `os:dev` to use `node packages/cli/dist/cli.js` instead of `tsx node_modules/@objectstack/cli/bin/objectstack.js`
- **`apps/console/package.json`**: Updated `start` script with same fix using relative path `../../packages/cli/dist/cli.js`

```diff
-"os:dev": "tsx node_modules/@objectstack/cli/bin/objectstack.js dev",
-"os:start": "tsx node_modules/@objectstack/cli/bin/objectstack.js serve",
+"os:dev": "node packages/cli/dist/cli.js dev",
+"os:start": "node packages/cli/dist/cli.js serve",
```
